001package dev.nandi0813.api;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.DivisionName;
004import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.LeaderboardType;
005import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.PlayerState;
006import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.WeightClass;
007import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.CosmeticsRegistry;
008import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.FFA;
009import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.HotbarItemRegistry;
010import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Match;
011import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.NameDecorationRegistry;
012import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Party;
013import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Queue;
014import dev.nandi0813.api.Utilities.PlayerNametag;
015import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
016
017import java.util.List;
018
019public abstract class ZonePracticeApi
020{
021
022    /**
023     * Incremented on every additive API release. 2.4.0 = 3, 2.5.0 = 4, 2.6.0 = 5.
024     */
025    public static final int API_VERSION = 5;
026
027    /**
028     * Use {@link #getInstance()}. Kept for binary compatibility; set by the core plugin only.
029     */
030    @Deprecated
031    public static ZonePracticeApi instance = null;
032
033    public static ZonePracticeApi getInstance() {
034        return instance;
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * Check whether ZonePractice Pro has registered its API implementation.
039     * @return true if {@link #getInstance()} returns a non-null instance
040     */
041    public static boolean isAvailable() {
042        return instance != null;
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * Get the player's division. Main thread only.
047     * @param player The player
048     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the division
049     * @return The player's division, or null if the player has no loaded profile
050     */
051    public abstract String getPlayerDivision(Player player, DivisionName divisionName);
052
053    /**
054     * Get the amount of unranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
055     * @param player The player
056     * @return The amount of unranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
057     */
058    public abstract int getPlayerUnRankedLeft(Player player);
059
060    /**
061     * Get the amount of ranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
062     * @param player The player
063     * @return The amount of ranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
064     */
065    public abstract int getPlayerRankedLeft(Player player);
066
067    /**
068     * Reset the player's unranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
069     * Main thread only.
070     * @param player The player
071     */
072    public abstract void resetPlayerUnRanked(Player player);
073
074    /**
075     * Reset the player's ranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
076     * Main thread only.
077     * @param player The player
078     */
079    public abstract void resetPlayerRanked(Player player);
080
081    /**
082     * Add unranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
083     * Main thread only.
084     * @param player The player
085     * @param amount The amount of unranked matches to add
086     */
087    public abstract void addPlayerUnRanked(Player player, int amount);
088
089    /**
090     * Add ranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
091     * Main thread only.
092     * @param player The player
093     * @param amount The amount of ranked matches to add
094     */
095    public abstract void addPlayerRanked(Player player, int amount);
096
097    /**
098     * End the match for the player. Does nothing if the player is not in a match.
099     * Main thread only.
100     * @param player The player
101     * @param endMessage The message to send to the match, in MiniMessage format. Nullable.
102     */
103    public abstract void endMatch(Player player, String endMessage);
104
105    /**
106     * Get the player's elo for a specific ladder. Main thread only.
107     * @param player The player
108     * @param ladder The ladder
109     * @return The player's elo, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile, the ladder name is unknown,
110     *         or the ladder is unranked-only
111     */
112    public abstract int getElo(Player player, String ladder);
113
114    /**
115     * Get the player's experience points. Main thread only.
116     * @param player The player
117     * @return The player's experience, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
118     */
119    public abstract int getExperience(Player player);
120
121    /**
122     * Get the player's wins for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
123     * @param player The player
124     * @param ladder The ladder
125     * @param weightClass The weight class
126     * @return The player's wins, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
127     */
128    public abstract int getLadderWins(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
129
130    /**
131     * Get the player's losses for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
132     * @param player The player
133     * @param ladder The ladder
134     * @param weightClass The weight class
135     * @return The player's losses, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
136     */
137    public abstract int getLadderLosses(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
138
139    /**
140     * Get the player's global wins. Main thread only.
141     * @param player The player
142     * @return The player's global wins (unranked + ranked), or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
143     */
144    public abstract int getGlobalWins(Player player);
145
146    /**
147     * Retrieves the nametag information of a given player. Main thread only.
148     *
149     * @param player The player whose nametag information is to be retrieved.
150     * @return The {@link PlayerNametag} associated with the specified player, containing
151     *         prefix, name color, and suffix components, or null if the player has no loaded profile.
152     */
153    public abstract PlayerNametag getPlayerNametag(Player player);
154
155    /**
156     * Get the player's current state. Main thread only.
157     * @param player The player
158     * @return The player's state, never null; {@link PlayerState#UNKNOWN} if the player has no loaded profile
159     */
160    public abstract PlayerState getPlayerState(Player player);
161
162    /**
163     * Get the live match the player fights in. Spectated matches are not returned. Main thread only.
164     * @param player The player
165     * @return The match, or null if the player is not fighting in a match
166     */
167    public abstract Match getMatch(Player player);
168
169    /**
170     * Get the match the player is spectating. Main thread only.
171     * @param player The player
172     * @return The spectated match, or null if the player is not spectating a match
173     */
174    public abstract Match getSpectatingMatch(Player player);
175
176    /**
177     * Get a match by its id, including matches that already ended. Main thread only.
178     * @param matchId The match id, see {@link Match#getMatchId()}
179     * @return The match, or null if no match has this id
180     * @since 2.6.0
181     */
182    public abstract Match getMatchById(String matchId);
183
184    /**
185     * Get the FFA the player fights in. Main thread only.
186     * @param player The player
187     * @return The FFA, or null if the player is not fighting in an FFA
188     */
189    public abstract FFA getFfa(Player player);
190
191    /**
192     * Get the event the player is in. Main thread only.
193     * @param player The player
194     * @return The event, or null if the player is not in an event
195     */
196    public abstract dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Event getEvent(Player player);
197
198    /**
199     * Get the party the player is in. Main thread only.
200     * @param player The player
201     * @return The party, or null if the player is not in a party
202     */
203    public abstract Party getParty(Player player);
204
205    /**
206     * Get the queue the player is in. Main thread only.
207     * @param player The player
208     * @return The queue, or null if the player is not queued
209     */
210    public abstract Queue getQueue(Player player);
211
212    /**
213     * Get the names of all enabled ladders. Main thread only.
214     * @return An unmodifiable list of ladder names, never null
215     */
216    public abstract List<String> getLadderNames();
217
218    /**
219     * Get the player's kills on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
220     * @param player The player
221     * @param ladder The ladder name
222     * @return The player's kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
223     */
224    public abstract int getLadderKills(Player player, String ladder);
225
226    /**
227     * Get the player's deaths on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
228     * @param player The player
229     * @param ladder The ladder name
230     * @return The player's deaths, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
231     */
232    public abstract int getLadderDeaths(Player player, String ladder);
233
234    /**
235     * Get the registry for addon cosmetics categories.
236     * @return The cosmetics registry, never null
237     */
238    public abstract CosmeticsRegistry getCosmeticsRegistry();
239
240    /**
241     * Get the registry for addon hotbar items.
242     * @return The hotbar item registry, never null
243     */
244    public abstract HotbarItemRegistry getHotbarItemRegistry();
245
246    /**
247     * Open the cosmetics hub for the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
248     * Main thread only.
249     * @param player The player
250     */
251    public abstract void openCosmeticsMenu(Player player);
252
253    /**
254     * Get the registry for name decorators.
255     * @return The name decoration registry, never null
256     */
257    public abstract NameDecorationRegistry getNameDecorationRegistry();
258
259    /**
260     * Get the player's current global win streak. Main thread only.
261     * @param player The player
262     * @return The win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
263     */
264    public abstract int getWinStreak(Player player);
265
266    /**
267     * Get the player's best global win streak. Main thread only.
268     * @param player The player
269     * @return The best win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
270     */
271    public abstract int getBestWinStreak(Player player);
272
273    /**
274     * Get the player's best win streak on a specific ladder and weight class. Main thread only.
275     * @param player The player
276     * @param ladder The ladder name
277     * @param weightClass The weight class
278     * @return The best win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
279     */
280    public abstract int getLadderBestWinStreak(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
281
282    /**
283     * Get the player's current FFA kill streak. Main thread only.
284     * @param player The player
285     * @return The kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
286     */
287    public abstract int getKillStreak(Player player);
288
289    /**
290     * Get the player's best global FFA kill streak. Main thread only.
291     * @param player The player
292     * @return The best kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
293     */
294    public abstract int getBestKillStreak(Player player);
295
296    /**
297     * Get the player's best FFA kill streak on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
298     * @param player The player
299     * @param ladder The ladder name
300     * @return The best kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
301     */
302    public abstract int getLadderBestKillStreak(Player player, String ladder);
303
304    /**
305     * Get the player's kills summed over all ladders. Main thread only.
306     * @param player The player
307     * @return The global kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
308     */
309    public abstract int getGlobalKills(Player player);
310
311    /**
312     * Get the player's global matches played (wins + losses). Main thread only.
313     * @param player The player
314     * @return The matches played, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
315     */
316    public abstract int getMatchesPlayed(Player player);
317
318    /**
319     * Get the time the player first joined the server. Main thread only.
320     * @param player The player
321     * @return The first join time in epoch millis, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
322     */
323    public abstract long getFirstJoin(Player player);
324
325    /**
326     * Get the names of all divisions, ordered lowest to highest. Main thread only.
327     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the divisions
328     * @return An unmodifiable list of division names, never null
329     */
330    public abstract List<String> getDivisionNames(DivisionName divisionName);
331
332    /**
333     * Get the player's position on a leaderboard. Main thread only.
334     * @param player The player
335     * @param type The statistic the leaderboard is ranked by
336     * @param ladder The ladder name, or null for the global leaderboard.
337     * @return The 1-based position, or -1 if the player is not on the leaderboard, the leaderboard does not exist,
338     *         or the ladder name is unknown. Leaderboards hold the top entries only and refresh periodically.
339     */
340    public abstract int getLeaderboardPosition(Player player, LeaderboardType type, String ladder);
341
342}
